scope: Targeted primary-source screen for Thai palm mill methane and allocation context; not imported into the current FAME activity chain

source.citation: Saswattecha, K.; Cuevas Romero, M.; Hein, L.; Jawjit, W.; Kroeze, C. (2015). Non-CO2 greenhouse gas emissions from palm oil production in Thailand. Journal of Integrative Environmental Sciences, 12(S1), 67-85.
source.data_period: 2012 current-situation mill estimates; production-capacity inputs referenced to DIT 2011/2012 and mill-operator communications
source.process: CPO mills; POME treatment and EFB disposal; management groups N-RSPO, P-RSPO, C-RSPO
source.functional_unit: Table 2 reports non-CO2 greenhouse-gas impact per ton CPO
locators: printed pp. 73-75, equations (1.2)-(3), Table 2 and adjoining text
source.publisher_pdf_download: blocked by publisher anti-bot challenge; web-extracted full text inspected; no local source PDF retained

method_and_limitations: The paper calculates non-CO2 emissions as activity data times emission factors; for POME, methane is estimated from COD-removal activity, including captured-biogas cases. This is a modeled category estimate, not a direct methane-flux observation for the present FAME chain.

The reported CPO mill values are allocated between CPO and palm kernel by mass using category-specific CPO:PK shares 0.75:0.25, 0.77:0.23, and 0.80:0.20. Do not apply these factors again to this paper's reported per-ton-CPO results, and do not transfer them to the 2019/2020 FAME case.

The study covers non-CO2 gases and states it excludes land-use-change effects and cannot quantify the relative importance of CO2 versus non-CO2 gases. Therefore it is not a full CPO carbon footprint or full lifecycle CO2e result.

The regional management groups and 2012 activity/capacity basis are not matched to the selected Mill 1/2019-2020 foreground providers. The paper does not provide the matched methane mass and actual CPO output for the selected mill and period required by the model.

decision.use: Private historical Thai CPO-mill benchmark and evidence of relevant pathways/allocation method only
decision.reason: different region/provider vintage and scenario grouping; modeled non-CO2 only; source visual table audit and redistribution license were not established

next_evidence_needed: Actual plant-level methane mass or measured/captured/slipped methane with a stated period and boundary
Actual CPO production for the same mill and period
Selected mill identity and wastewater/EFB treatment configuration linking the measurements to the current chain
Allocation basis for the current 2019/2020 source tables and confirmation whether reported burdens are already allocated
Visual cell-level verification plus explicit reuse/redistribution license before any table values are republished
